d: Short, honey-blonde hair with a blunt cut and thick bangs. Sharp, narrow red eyes with a focused expression. A youthful appearance with a slender, athletic build. Wearing a navy blue military-style jacket with gold trim, a short white pleated skirt, a flowing royal blue cape with a golden lining, and thigh-high navy blue lace-up boots. Accessories include a large black mechanical shield and a massive white futuristic lance with blue glowing accents.
